text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Tsuyoshi! Don't you give up, 
Tsuyoshi! Give it everything you've got—!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "I can run in the race! I can run!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't want a race I'll 
regret. ...Please watch over me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go give it everything I've 
got!
